description: Content creator Sydney Towle, who inspired millions by documenting her battle with a rare form of cancer, has died at the age of 26. In the days following her death, an emotional clip from a 2025 podcast interview has resurfaced online, with many calling it a powerful reminder of the legacy she leaves behind. Sydney's brother Austin Towle recalled her final days.
title: Influencer Sydney Towle dies at 26 after rare cancer battle

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Ajinkya Rahane, who recently announced his retirement from all forms of cricket, scored 5,077 runs in 85 Tests at an average of 38.46, including 12 centuries and 26 half-centuries. He also played 90 ODIs, scoring 2962 runs at an average of 35.26, including 3 hundreds and 24 fifties. He also featured in 20 T20Is for India.
title: 'I was India's 12th man for two years': Ajinkya Rahane reveals

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: In a bold move to safeguard the community, New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani has mandated that online retailers cease the sale of illegal high-speed e-bikes, aiming to improve public safety and reduce tragic incidents. Additionally, the mayor has suggested launching five city-funded grocery stores throughout the city, which would provide essential goods at significantly reduced prices, ensuring that average New Yorkers benefit from substantial savings each year.
title: Zohran Mamdani tells Amazon, Walmart and 40 others: Stop selling these devices

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: On Friday, oil prices experienced a modest rise amid shipping uncertainties in the Strait of Hormuz. Traders exhibit caution regarding transit through this critical route. Meanwhile, US President Donald Trump hinted at a potential resolution to the ongoing conflict. Additionally, Iran and Oman are exploring new transit options for the waterway. As developments unfolded, market trends reversed previous declines.
title: Oil prices rise 1% as Middle East conflict continues Hormuz shipping disruption

author: ANUJA JAISWAL
description: Candidates holding temporary disability certificates can now pursue MBBS admissions, reflecting significant changes in the National Medical Commission's policies. The revised guidelines indicate that admission requests from persons with disabilities will be subject to assessment by medical boards. It is noteworthy that the presence of progressive or non-progressive disabilities will not inherently prevent admission, with a thorough evaluation of functional competency taking place.
title: Temporary disability certificate won't deny MBBS seat for students PwBD quota: NMC

author: MANASH PRATIM GOHAIN
description: Nearly all Indian students heading overseas for education plan to come back home after their studies. What's striking is that about 90% are pioneering this journey as the first in their families to study abroad. This trend highlights a shift towards self-driven decisions among students. Business and management fields are particularly appealing, with many utilizing Google searches and agents to find their perfect educational fit.
title: Survey reveals about 81% of study-abroad aspirants plan to return home

author: AABHAS SHARMA
description: In a significant shift, alternative-fuel passenger vehicles have captured forty percent of the retail market, nearly matching petrol-powered models, which hold a slender one percent lead. July marked the highest sales figures for automobiles ever recorded. Additionally, electric two-wheelers are experiencing unprecedented market penetration, highlighting changing consumer preferences towards cost-effective options.
title: Alternative-fuel passenger vehicles fast catching up with petrol ones

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: In a show of support, Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis has championed Nitesh Tiwari's upcoming film 'Ramayana'. He expressed optimism that this mythological masterpiece will capture an Oscar, citing its impressive scale and production quality. The initial installment is slated for release in November 2026, with the date officially confirmed by Sony Pictures. Read on to know more in detail.
title: Devendra Fadnavis roots for 'Ramayana' winning an Oscar

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: India's preparations for the two-Test series against Sri Lanka could be affected by rain, with wet weather forecast in Colombo during the three-day warm-up match against Sri Lanka XI. Heavy showers are expected from Friday morning to Sunday afternoon, raising doubts over how much playing time both teams will get before the first Test in Galle.
title: Rain threat looms large over IND vs SL three-day warm-up match

author: AYUSH PANDEY
title: US court slaps Meta with $567 million penalty in landmark child safety ruling

author: MAHIYAR PATEL AND MANASH PRATIM GOHAIN
description: Mohan Bhagwat advocated for system correction through protests and increased education budgets. He opposed social media bans and favored dialogue with Pakistan and China. Traditional family structures should be upheld while creating space for same-sex relationships. Bhagwat explained women's independence from the RSS apex decision-making body. Societal disrespect for manual labor causes competition for government jobs, he stated.
title: If asked whom to believe, I’ll say Gen Z: RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat

author: AYUSH PANDEY
title: Trump signs new executive orders on birthright citizenship despite court setback

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: At Keawakapu Beach, Democratic congressional hopeful Kirill Basin encountered serious legal issues after reportedly threatening individuals with a knife and a gun. A bystander, trained in martial arts, bravely intervened and rendered Basin unconscious during the altercation. Now charged with terroristic threatening, Basin faces a one million dollar bail, further complicated by a troubling history of previous arrests for assault and property damage.
title: Hawaii candidate Kirill Basin charged, held on $1M bail after Maui beach clash

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Priyanka Chopra Jonas has announced her next Hollywood venture, a sci-fi action thriller.  She will star opposite Russell Crowe in the film titled 'Bluefly'.  The movie's plot involves a deep Congo mission to recover a mysterious downed aircraft.  This project marks another significant international role for the acclaimed Indian actress.  'Bluefly' is scheduled for production and release in the future.
title: Priyanka Chopra joins Russell Crowe in Hollywood sci-fi action thriller 'Bluefly'

author: TNN
description: In a significant move, the Supreme Court has granted interim bail for one week to Sumit Roy, who serves as the personal assistant to TMC general secretary Abhishek Banerjee. Roy is implicated in the Salboni land-grabbing case, which followed the arrest of former TMC MLA Sujoy Hazra. Notably, the court has stayed Roy's arrest until it reconvenes for the next hearing.
title: Land-grab case: Supeme Court grants interim bail to Abhishek's PA

author: TNN
description: The BJP has called out Congress leaders Rahul Gandhi and Mallikarjun Kharge for allegedly spreading misinformation. They assert that Home Minister Shah is present at Parliament House, but is unable to participate due to ongoing protests. Continued disruptions by the opposition hinder legislative work, yet Shah is ready to address their concerns directly. The BJP confirmed Shah is in his office daily, awaiting the resumption of parliamentary activities.
title: BJP to Congress: Let House function, Amit Shah will come

author: SUBODH GHILDIYAL
description: Rahul Gandhi took to Instagram to voice his support for student protests, labeling the education system as deeply flawed and in need of urgent reform. His remarks were made following a meeting with NEET protesters who detailed their encounters with police brutality. The students bravely shared stories of discrimination they faced while advocating for their rights.
title: Rahul reaches out to Gen Z through Instagram, backs student protest in Jharkhand

author: SUBODH GHILDIYAL
description: Uttar Pradesh Congress MPs are actively pushing for a partnership with the Samajwadi Party, considering it vital to mount a formidable challenge to the BJP in the upcoming elections. With a strong consensus among the MPs for quick action, party leaders are currently assessing viable constituencies and gathering data to facilitate negotiations, striving to strengthen their united front against the BJP's dominance in the state.
title: Congress MPs urge leadership to seek SP alliance talks ahead of UP polls

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Filming for the Michael Jackson biopic sequel is slated to begin by year's end.  The production company aims for a potential 2027 release date for the film.  This sequel follows the significant worldwide success of the first movie.  Some omitted elements from the initial film may appear in the new installment.  The company reported overall financial gains due to recent film successes.
title: ‘Michael 2’ under way, film makers to start shooting by 2026 end

author: DHANANJAY MAHAPATRA
description: The Supreme Court will continue CBI investigations into defaulting realtors. Builders cannot escape probes by settling with only a few homebuyers. Many bank officials are found to have colluded with these builders. CBI has completed probes in eighteen of fifty registered cases. Banks must grant prosecution sanctions for accused officials within two weeks.
title: Settling with a few cases won't stop CBI probe: Supreme Court warns realtors

author: TNN
description: The Rajya Sabha approved the Appropriation Bill, 2026, authorizing fund withdrawals for excess expenditure. Opposition members repeatedly demanded Home Minister Amit Shah's presence in the House.  Parliamentary affairs minister Kiren Rijiju was asked to convey their sentiments to Shah.  Leader of the Opposition Mallikarjun Kharge sought the Home Minister's statement on student police action.  The opposition also requested the Prime Minister's apology for the alleged police excesses.
title: Kharge-Rijiju face-off in Rajya Sabha; opposition stalls House over Amit Shah

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Jana Nayagan's box office collections saw a decline on its fifteenth day. The film has now surpassed Rs 300 crore in worldwide gross collections. Its India net collection reached Rs 185.15 crore after fifteen days. Tamil Nadu remained the strongest market, contributing significantly to daily earnings. The movie's performance reflects Vijay's enduring star power.
title: Jana Nayagan day 15: Thalapathy Vijay film grosses Rs 308.67 crore worldwide

author: SAHIL MALHOTRA
description: India begin their three-day warm-up fixture against Sri Lanka XI at the NCC in Colombo today. The Shubman Gill-led unit has already had two intense training sessions and a largely rested squad means the team feels fresh for the crucial series starting August 15. There are some injury concerns: Jasprit Bumrah, Washington Sundar, and Sai Sudharsan. However, the squad has enough quality to secure a scoreline that keeps their World Test Championship final chances alive.
title: India's search for answers to rediscover lost glory in Tests begins in Colombo

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: At 97, Betty Bromage has broken her own Guinness World Record as the oldest female wing walker. The Cheltenham resident completed the daring challenge to raise funds for the stroke unit at Cheltenham General Hospital, where she was treated after suffering a stroke in 2025, proving resilience knows no age.
title: 97-year-old Betty Bromage breaks own record as oldest female wing walker

author: SOUMITRA BOSE
description: A 19-year-old Thane youth was moved to the ICU after complaining of health issues. He is accused of holding a teenage girl captive and sexually torturing her. The survivor underwent plastic surgery for deep wounds inflicted by a surgical blade. Police are seeking cyber experts to unlock seized mobile phones for clues. The accused demanded VIP treatment and refused to cooperate with the investigation.
title: Nagpur rape accused in ICU, survivor battles scars in general ward of same hospital

author: TOI
description: HC Tears Through Trial Court’s  Judgement
title: Bombay high court overturns Tejpal acquittal, awards 10-year jail term

author: RAJ SHEKHAR JHA
description: The Delhi Police successfully arrested Rajinder Bairagi, a long-sought fugitive connected to a 1998 murder case. For nearly thirty years, he managed to evade law enforcement by living under a false identity in Madhya Pradesh. During the investigation, authorities also resolved two previously unsolved attempted murder cases from 1997 using leads tied to him. His elaborate disguise was ultimately dismantled following comprehensive surveillance operations.
title: Fake IDs, dual lives & a dramatic escape: The 28-yr saga of killer Rajinder Bairagi

author: SAMSON RAJ
description: In a tragic incident, two intoxicated young men crashed their vehicle into a scooty carrying medical students, resulting in one student being declared brain dead. The police have taken swift action, arresting Suravarapu Daswanth and Andrew Joseph Edwards. Prior to the crash, the pair had been refused entry to a mall due to their drunken state. Legal proceedings are now underway against the individuals for their reckless actions.
title: Video: Andhra medical student dies after car driven by ‘drunk’ youth rams her scooty
